newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire-Tyne says Q1 ad revenue up 5.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire-Tyne says Q1 ad revenue up 5.5 pct.

text.p: Britain's Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc said on Friday its advertising revenue in the first quarter of 1997 was 5.5 percent up on the corresponding year-earlier period.
"In particular, we have seen a very substantial increase in local advertising," Ward Thomas, YTT's chairman and chief executive told the company's annual shareholders' meeting.
Thomas said the firm expected to get a share of revenue from a number of advertising campaigns which would come to its broadcast area as the year progressed.
YTT is a broadcaster for the Independent Television network (ITV) in north and north-east England.
"We are also pleased that we continue to keep staff numbers and operating costs under control and end the first quarter some 0.5 million stg under budget," he said.
